method: Each newly surfaced title-first top-5 hit with no recorded label was judged against displayed source evidence (title, ingredient list, reported total) under evals/rubric_v1.md and the checkpoint1 label schema. Reasons paraphrase the evidence; no source text is quoted. Time checks are mechanical from reported TotalTime; equipment preserved unenforced per the DEV-25 pattern. v2: 5 recipes surfaced only by the title boost added (origin h6_title_boost_pool); explanations and DEV-25 equipment evidence corrected after review of the stored recipes.
owner_review: Checkpoint D 2026-10-08: the owner accepted the recommended grades (row 3 = 1, all others 2) and the corrected explanations and suitability; recorded by an AI assistant, not a signature.
review_status: Owner-accepted at Checkpoint D (recorded by an AI assistant; not a signature). Never edit checkpoint1_corrections.json or any frozen benchmark with this file.
